source.name: Red Bull Ring
source.widthNote: Published pre-chicane course width range; 12.5 m is a nominal estimate for the F1 course.
source.elevationNote: Reconstructed 65 m height range. The range is sourced; the longitudinal profile and intermediate heights are inferred, not surveyed.
source.runoffNote: Default gameplay runoff: 20 m of grass on each side, editable per zone. This deliberately differs from real-world safety areas, especially at street circuits.
source.layoutNote: F1 route, without the separate MotoGP chicane. Uses the requested 4,326 m catalog length rather than the 4,318 m geographic-dataset value.
